`mcsimr` is a local-first R package and Shiny workbench for Monte Carlo
simulation studies. The package is designed so simulation decisions can be
made in a graphical interface, exported as R code, and rerun as a reproducible
Quarto project.

## Launch the app

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(mcsimr)
use_mcsimr_app()
```

## Run a small OLS simulation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
spec <- ols_sim_spec(
  n = c(100, 250),
  reps = 100,
  betas = c(0.20, 0.30, 0.00),
  predictor_correlation = c(0.00, 0.30),
  error_sd = 1,
  seed = 20260608
)

study <- run_simulation_study(
  spec,
  workers = 2,
  checkpoint_dir = "results/checkpoints/ols-demo",
  resume = TRUE
)

study$summary
```

## Export a Quarto project

```{r, eval = FALSE}
export_quarto_project(
  spec,
  path = "mcsimr-report",
  workers = 2,
  checkpoint_dir = "results/checkpoints"
)
```
